title: feat(plugin-gantt): the gantt takes its own row ceiling, 10,000, instead of the shared 2,000
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D1JZC5GavhRLTzpykhrBy1p)_

Fixes #32421

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
1. 改了什么:甘特图不再共用其他非表格视图的 2,000 行上限,改用自己的常量 `GANTT_ROW_CEILING` = 10,000;日历、地图、树形图仍是 2,000。
2. 为什么改:卡片作者的排产甘特有 4,999 行,升级前只画前 2,000 行并提示截断;甘特本身是虚拟滚动的,行数多不增加页面元素,2,000 是按不虚拟化的树形图定的。
3. 风险与回滚:每次打开甘特最多取 10,001 行(以前 2,001);实测 10,000 行约 1 MB 数据、浏览器约 0.45 秒画出首屏。回滚只需还原本 PR。
4. 先看:`ui/packages/core/src/utils/non-grid-row-ceiling.ts`(新常量、实测表、两个函数的 ceiling 参数);`ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`(查询与截断改用新常量);`ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.harness.test.tsx`(新增 4,999 行与 pageSize 两条用例)。
5. 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.harness.test.tsx`,预期全绿,其中「between the shared and the gantt ceiling」一条画出 4,999 行且无截断提示。
6. 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Ruling B on #32421 (comment 6842306915): the gantt leaves the shared 2,000-row non-grid ceiling, which the non-virtualised tree prices, and takes a ceiling of its own, a named renderer constant set by measurement.

- `@object-ui/core`: `GANTT_ROW_CEILING = 10000` next to `NON_GRID_ROW_CEILING`, with the measured table in its doc comment. `nonGridRowCeilingQuery(ceiling?)` and `applyNonGridRowCeiling(result, ceiling?)` take an optional ceiling typed as `NonGridRowCeiling`, the closed union of the two constants, so a view-metadata number cannot be passed without a visible cast. Leaving the argument out keeps 2,000, so calendar, map and tree are unchanged byte for byte at their call sites.
- `@object-ui/plugin-gantt`: `ObjectGantt`'s reload sends `$top = GANTT_ROW_CEILING + 1` and slices at the same ceiling. Above it, the probe row and `NonGridRowCeilingNote` work exactly as before.
- Not changed, by the ruling: `pagination.pageSize` and `limit` stay unread by the gantt; the datasource's `external.rowCap` is not read; no `packages/spec` change.
- The value is a literal 10,000, equal to `EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP_CEILING` but not imported from it, so raising the spec's cap cannot raise this one unmeasured.

## Measurement (owed before the constant was fixed)

<details><summary>Fetch and first paint at 2,000 / 4,000 / 10,000 rows: inside budget at 10,000</summary>

Same method as the existing table in `non-grid-row-ceiling.ts` (this repo's DOM test lane, `@testing-library/react`, `ObjectGantt` over the real `GanttView`, mount to settled paint), the gantt alone, one sitting, shared box. "adapter" parses the rows from a JSON wire string inside `find()` (the fetch's deserialisation half). "Chromium" is headless Chromium on the Console's Vite dev server, a temporary page mounting `ObjectGantt` with a `find()` that `fetch`es a JSON blob, mount to the first frame after rows reach the DOM. Format: DOM elements · ms.

| rows | DOM lane, inline (2 passes) | DOM lane, adapter (payload, parse) | Chromium (2 passes) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2,000 | 726 · 137 / 130 | 732 · 111 (0.20 MB, 3ms) | 623 · 396 / 383 |
| 4,000 | 726 · 146 / 150 | 732 · 132 (0.41 MB, 4ms) | 623 · 466 / 454 |
| 10,000 | 726 · 197 / 240 | 732 · 235 (1.02 MB, 20ms) | 623 · 436 / 457 |
| 10,500 | 727 · 216, note shows "first 10000 of 10500" | n/a | 624 · 408, same note |

Budget (ruling a′'s, applied to the gantt): DOM far inside ~10,000 elements and mount inside the ~3s the tree is held to. At 10,000 rows the DOM is flat at 726 and mount is about 0.2s in the DOM lane and about 0.45s in Chromium, so 10,000 is within budget and is the value. For scale, the existing table has the tree at 10,406 elements · 2,720ms for 2,000 rows.

Not measured: a fetch from a running ObjectStack server (no backend stack was started in this container; the Chromium reading fetches a same-page JSON blob, so it prices transfer-free parse and mount, not server read time or network).

Also in Chromium at 10,000 rows: the timeline scrolls to row 10,000 (scroll height 400,000px = 10,000 × 40px rows), and dragging row 10,000's bar called the adapter's `update('10000', { visible_from: '2026-01-04', due_date: '2026-04-03' })`, a 3-day shift: drag write-back works at the far end of the set.

The temporary page, harness and screenshots were deleted; nothing of them is committed.
</details>

## Tests

- `@object-ui/core` `non-grid-row-ceiling.test.ts`: new block. CONTROL: with no argument both helpers keep 2,000 (4,999 rows truncate to 2,000); the gantt query is `GANTT_ROW_CEILING + 1`; 4,999 rows are kept whole under the gantt ceiling; one past it truncates and slices the probe row.
- `ObjectGantt.harness.test.tsx`: the existing ceiling, inline-provider, host-prop and filter-then-ceiling cases move to `GANTT_ROW_CEILING` (the past-ceiling totals now exceed 10,000; `ceilingOrder` uses 12,000 raw rows filtered to 4,000). New: 4,999 rows between the two ceilings draw whole with no note and `$top` 10,001; an authored `pagination.pageSize` and `limit` of 50 or 50,000 change nothing.
- `ObjectGantt.elementDataSource.test.tsx`: the authored-`limit` pin now expects the gantt ceiling's `$top`.
- Tree / calendar / map controls: their unchanged `rowCeiling-7210` files still pin `nonGridRowCeilingQuery()` (2,001) and pass.

<details><summary>Ablation (measured)</summary>

With the fix committed, `ObjectGantt.tsx` was mutated back to `nonGridRowCeilingQuery()` and `applyNonGridRowCeiling(result)` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed). `ObjectGantt.harness.test.tsx` + `ObjectGantt.elementDataSource.test.tsx`: 9 failed | 53 passed, including the between-ceilings case, the pageSize case and every past-ceiling case. Restored: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. ui tests import `@object-ui/*` source through the vitest aliases, so no dist rebuild was involved.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: `@object-ui/core`'s entry gains `GANTT_ROW_CEILING`, the `NonGridRowCeiling` type and an optional parameter on two exported functions; nothing existing narrows. `Metadata-protocol: none`: no key, value or default an author writes changes, so both packages ship `patch`.
- The existing table's header says it was measured in the "jsdom lane"; `ui/vitest.config.mts` runs the DOM projects on happy-dom today. The new reading says "DOM test lane" and does not re-label the old one.

## Verification

Local subset at `6b2b52ef` (pre-merge head; the merge of `origin/main` into `a343f613` touched no file under `ui/packages/core`, `ui/packages/plugin-gantt` or `ui/packages/react`, so only the diff-scoped changeset gates were re-run there, exit 0). Full fleet: CI.

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/ packages/plugin-gantt/`: Test Files 334 passed | 1 skipped (335), Tests 5212 passed | 141 skipped.
- Cross-view ceiling files (core, react note, gantt harness / elementDataSource / contractEnvelope, tree / calendar / map `rowCeiling-7210`): Test Files 113 passed (113), Tests 1993 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core run type-check` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-gantt run type-check` exit 0; `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations` exit 0 (0 new citations).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 36 derived families accounted for, 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, every one exit 0 (`check-sdui-manifest` included).
